command: set -euo pipefail; B=/var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share; echo IDENTITY_HOST=$(hostname); echo IDENTITY_USER=$(id -un); echo SERVICE_BEFORE=$(systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p MainPID -p ActiveEnterTimestamp --value | tr '\n' '|'); for p in "$B/agentzero/consciousness.db" "$B/agentzero/unified.db" "$B/agentzero/welt.db" "$B/frank/db/amygdala.db" "$B/frank/db/world_experience.db" "$B/frank/db/world_experience.db.vor-maerz-20260910"; do echo DB_BEGIN=$p; if [ -f "$p" ]; then echo EXISTS=1; stat -c 'BYTES=%s MODE=%a MTIME=%Y' "$p"; sha256sum "$p" | awk '{print "SHA256="$1}'; sqlite3 -readonly "$p" 'PRAGMA quick_check; SELECT count(*) FROM sqlite_master WHERE type="table" AND name NOT LIKE "sqlite_%";' | sed 's/^/SQL=/' ; else echo EXISTS=0; fi; echo DB_END=$p; done; echo SERVICE_AFTER=$(systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p MainPID -p ActiveEnterTimestamp --value | tr '\n' '|'); echo DONE=1
